content.short: IntelliJ IDEA is a code editor built for the Javascript Virtual Machine.
content.description: IntelliJ IDEA remains primarily a Web2 development environment. For Ethereum development, developers can install language plugins to support their preferred languages and workflows. The product is not entirely free and includes a paid Ultimate tier with additional features. It emphasizes customization, giving developers control over their interface, including adjustable highlight colors and layouts to suit personal preferences and project needs.
